item.title: My Kids NEVER Asked For Screen Time Again
item.description:
I'm not anti-technology, but watching my kids turn into zombies swiping through feeds? I hate it. We keep devices locked down, airplane mode only, basically. But last night I figured something out. Instead of fighting over screen time, I opened ChatGPT with my kids and we built bedtime stories together characters, plot, the whole thing. Then I had it generate a book cover. They were waiting for it to render like it was Christmas morning. No scrolling. No ADD spiral. Just imagination, creativity, and a little patience. Jonathan Haidt, if you're watching, I think I found something.

item.title: Macklemore Got Dropped. Here’s What EVERYONE Is Missing
item.description:
#macklemore #edsheeran
Macklemore gets dropped. Opening acts pull out of Ed Sheeran’s tour. Suddenly everyone is talking about free speech. But is that really what this controversy is about? I break down the Macklemore - Ed Sheeran spectacle, the selective use of “free speech,” what’s actually being communicated by the slogans surrounding the anti-Israel movement, and why this entire controversy feels like a microcosm of the larger Israel–Palestinian conflict. Sometimes the slogan sounds a lot better than the ideology behind it.
